mod_csata_leiras: Free match against a bot: four ages, age advance, land warfare.
mod_kaloz_leiras: The Caribbean islands: pirate factions, no age advance, sugar cane and rum, and plunder brings fame — but fame brings the royal fleet.
mod_hadjarat_leiras: A historical mission series per nation: every map has its own objective, age and enemy. Your progress is kept.
kimerul: %d workers on it — depleted in about %d s
gyulekezo_kijelol: Click the map: new units will go there.
gyulekezo_nincs: No rally point — new units stay by the building. (Right-click on the map also sets it.)
gyulekezo_point: Rally point: new units will head here.
gyulekezo_node: Rally point: new workers will start working here.
gyulekezo_foe: Rally point: new soldiers will attack this.
beall_reszletesseg_sugo: On an old, weak machine set this to low: fewer moving details, less frequent fog and minimap updates. The map and the gameplay stay the same.
hamarosan: This part has not been built in the Godot version yet.
halozat_nincs: Multiplayer: a local battle against bots, or a network match with a room code — up to eight sides.
csata_sugo: Everyone starts with their own town and stockpile. Sides sharing a team number are allies; with separate numbers it is everyone against everyone.
ach_elso_ver_d: Destroy an enemy unit or building.
okt_kijelol: Select a worker: left-click on one.
okt_gyujt: Put them to work: right-click a forest or a quarry.
okt_haz: Build a House from the panel on the right — it raises your population limit.
okt_laktanya: Build Barracks: that is where soldiers come from.
okt_katona: Select the barracks and train an Infantry.
okt_tamad: Send your soldier at the enemy: right-click on them.
okt_kesz: Done! You know the basics now. Good luck with your empire.
net_sugo: The room opens on your machine, and the match runs there too. The others type YOUR ADDRESS (e.g. 192.168.0.12:27015) — the lobby shows exactly what to give them. The room code is the same thing, shorter. Up to eight sides.
net_upnp_keres: Opening a port on the router…
net_upnp_kesz: The router opened a port: anyone can join with the internet code.
net_upnp_nem: The router did not open a port by itself. Either enable UPnP on it, or forward UDP port %d to this machine by hand — then your friend can join using your public IP and that port. If that is not possible, a VPN (Tailscale, ZeroTier, Hamachi) works too: type the VPN address instead.
net_te_vagy_hazigazda: You are the host: the match runs on your machine and you start it.
net_hazigazda_indit: Connected. The host starts the match.
net_nem_nyilt: Could not open a room: the port is busy.
net_rossz_kod: Bad address. Type the host's address and port (e.g. 192.168.0.12:27015), or the eight-letter room code.
net_nem_ert_el: Cannot reach the host at that address.
net_hazigazda_elment: The host left; the match has ended.
szoba_nyitas_relay: Open a room through a relay
net_relay_sugo: On this route NOBODY has to open a port on their router: everyone connects outwards to the relay, and it forwards the packets. So you can play from different wifi networks, even from different countries. The relay is this same game started with `--relay=27020` — it is enough if one of you runs it on a reachable machine.
net_relay_rossz_cim: Type the relay address, for example relay.host.net:27020.
net_relay_nem_ert_el: Cannot reach the relay at that address.
net_relay_tele: The relay has no free rooms left.
net_relay_nincs_szoba: There is no such room on the relay.
